cues: Inside, it crosses the cortex by parallel routes.
The apoplast route runs through the cell walls and the spaces between cells, never crossing a membrane; it is the fastest.
The symplast route runs from cytoplasm to cytoplasm, through plasmodesmata.
A third, transmembrane route crosses membranes through water channels called aquaporins.
